messages:
sam: quick ping — opened a small PR that touches auth proxy headers and k8s sa mapping for onprem. link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321>. Can you do a security skim? specifically worried about token scope and any secret leakage in sidecar config.

neha: looking now. main things I'll check: 1) env var usage (no raw secrets in manifests), 2) k8s sa scope (least privilege), 3) kms paths for onprem. ping me if you want a quick call.

alim: noted. this is in the onprem branch that will go in next canary. are we planning a canary first or go straight to reserved window?

sam: canary first. aiming for canary tomorrow morning during EU low-traffic. will follow with reserved merge if no issues.

sec-bot: secret-scan: no high-confidence secret detections in changed files. (scan id: ss-2026-03-17-09).

neha: saw the PR diff — the only sticky bit is the projected SA token ttl change (default 1h -> 6h). can we keep TTL at 1h and instead add short-lived refresh path? expanding TTL raises blast radius for onprem.

sam: OK fair. I moved the TTL change to a separate opt-in flag behind feature gate. default stays 1h. snippet:```yaml
env:
  - name: SA_TOKEN_TTL
    value: "3600"
featureFlags:
  enableExtendedTokenTtl: false
```

marta: +1 on leaving default 1h. also suggest adding an audit log entry for token refresh attempts so we can spot abnormal refresh rates.

neha: agree. add an entry to the rollout checklist: "verify token refresh audit logs present and forwarded to SIEM".

sam: added checklist item in the PR description. also added minimal logging. can you re-check quick?

neha: re-checking… logs are fine, they include uid, sa, refresh_time, and request_ip. just one more ask: gate the KMS path used for token encryption to the onprem KMS service account only. currently the secret path is pluralized (project/shared/kms) — narrow it to project/onprem/kms.

sam: will update.

alim: once neha gives final ok, what's the merge window? I can standby for canary rollout at 08:00 PT tomorrow.

marta: I can own monitoring during canary. I'll keep the rollback plan ready (revert PR + restart sidecar).

neha: LGTM after kms path change and keeping TTL default. no privacy concerns beyond that. please annotate the PR with the privacy review checkbox. :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks all — updating PR now. merging strategy: canary @ 08:00 PT (alim deploys), monitor 30m, if green promote to reserved at 11:00 PT.

marta: noted. I'll open a short incident channel if anything spikes.

sam: final: thanks neha for quick review. I'll tag the PR with the security signoff when kms path updated.

sec-bot: policy-check: KMS path policy requires role 'onprem-kms-operator' for encryption/decryption. No policy violations found after TTL remained default. (policy run id: pol-887).
